title: tsflow
description: Health, traffic and runtime for tsflow's Prometheus metrics (TSFLOW_METRICS_ADDR).

list.name: window
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Window for rate() and quantiles. Counters move once per poll, so keep it at two or three times TSFLOW_POLL_INTERVAL (5m by default).

panels.title: Poller
panels.description: 1 while each tailnet's poll loop runs (tsflow_poller_up). `backend` is api, s3 or gcs.

panels.title: Flow log lag
panels.description: Now minus the start of the newest stored minute. With the API backend this normally sits around TSFLOW_POLL_DELAY plus the poll interval (about 7 to 12 minutes with the defaults). Yellow past 15 minutes, red past 30.

panels.title: Since last good poll
panels.description: Time since each tailnet's last successful poll. Yellow past 10 minutes, red past 15 (three default poll intervals).

panels.title: Poll errors
panels.description: Failed polls in the selected rate window, all selected tailnets.

panels.title: DB size
panels.description: SQLite file plus its -wal and -shm files.

panels.title: Row counters
panels.description: The per-minute pair row counters rebuild in the background after an upgrade. Queries that use them are slower until this reads Ready.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: tsflow_build_info. Shows every version that reported in the time range.

panels.title: Startup migrations
panels.description: Time the startup schema migrations and rollup backfills took (tsflow_db_init_duration_seconds).

panels.title: Counter rebuild took
panels.description: How long the background pair row counter rebuild took. 0 until it finishes, and on a fresh database.

panels.title: Rows in last poll
panels.description: Flow log rows the latest poll ingested, per tailnet.

panels.title: Scrape read errors
panels.description: Store reads that failed while serving /metrics, in the selected window. Anything above 0 means some health gauges were skipped.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx in the selected window.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests per second across every route, selected window.

panels.title: Poll duration p50 / p95
panels.description: Successful polls. Polls run once per TSFLOW_POLL_INTERVAL, so keep the rate window at two or three intervals or the quantiles go blank between polls.

panels.title: Ingest rate
panels.description: Flow log rows ingested per second, per tailnet. Rows land once per poll, so this is averaged over the rate window. A catch-up after downtime shows as a spike.

panels.title: Poll errors
panels.description: Failed polls per tailnet in each rate window. Should be flat at 0.

panels.title: Flow log lag
panels.description: Now minus the newest stored minute, per tailnet. The sawtooth is the poll cycle; a line that keeps climbing means ingest has stopped.

panels.title: DB size
panels.description: SQLite file plus WAL and shared memory.

panels.title: Process uptime vs. counters
panels.description: Restarts reset the counters above. This shows uptime so you can tell a reset from a real drop.

panels.title: HTTP p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile latency per route template. UI pages and unknown paths share route="other". Routes with no requests in the window drop out.

panels.title: HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Requests per second by status code. 5xx is drawn in red.

panels.title: MCP tool calls
panels.description: MCP tool calls per second by tool and result. Empty unless TSFLOW_MCP_ENABLED=true and an agent is calling tools.

defaults.noValue: No MCP calls (TSFLOW_MCP_ENABLED off or idle)

panels.title: MCP tool p95
panels.description: 95th percentile MCP tool latency by tool.

defaults.noValue: No MCP calls (TSFLOW_MCP_ENABLED off or idle)

panels.title: Bytes/s by traffic type
panels.description: Bytes sent per second by traffic type, counted once by the sender. Counters move once per poll, so this is averaged over the rate window. Physical is the WireGuard transport under the others and is hidden from the stack; click it in the legend to see it.

panels.title: Bytes/s by protocol
panels.description: TCP, UDP and everything else, physical transport excluded.

panels.title: Packets/s by traffic type
panels.description: Packets per second by traffic type.

panels.title: Flows/s by traffic type
panels.description: Flow records per second by traffic type.

panels.title: Window
panels.description: Seconds of data behind the last-15-minute gauges below. Below 900 for the first 15 minutes after a start.

panels.title: Window ends
panels.description: How far behind now the last-15-minute window ends. It ends at the start of the newest ingested minute, so it tracks the flow log lag.

panels.title: Window compute
panels.description: How long the last window computation took. It runs at most every 30 seconds, on scrape.

panels.title: Top tags, last 15 min
panels.description: Traffic by device tag over the last 15 minutes: the top 20 tags, then `other`, plus `untagged` and `unknown` (addresses that aren't a tailnet device). A device with two tags counts in both. Sent plus received. `other` is left out here; the table has it.

panels.title: Tags, last 15 min
panels.description: Traffic by device tag over the last 15 minutes: the top 20 tags, then `other`, plus `untagged` and `unknown` (addresses that aren't a tailnet device). A device with two tags counts in both. Bytes sent and received in the window, every series including `other`.

panels.title: Top users, last 15 min
panels.description: Traffic by device owner over the last 15 minutes: the top 20, then `other`. Tagged devices are owned by `tagged-devices`. Sent plus received. `other` is left out here; the table has it.

panels.title: Users, last 15 min
panels.description: Traffic by device owner over the last 15 minutes: the top 20, then `other`. Tagged devices are owned by `tagged-devices`. Bytes sent and received in the window, every series including `other`.

panels.title: Top ports, last 15 min
panels.description: Bytes by service port over the last 15 minutes. The remainder bucket (protocol=other, port=other) is left out here; the table has it.

panels.title: Ports, last 15 min
panels.description: Bytes by service port over the last 15 minutes, including the remainder bucket.

panels.title: Top talkers, last 15 min
panels.description: Devices that moved the most bytes in the window, sent plus received. Only present with TSFLOW_METRICS_TOP_TALKERS set. It's a current ranking, not a history per device.

panels.title: Top talkers, last 15 min
panels.description: Bytes each top device sent and received in the window.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time per second. 1.0 is one full core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set, Go heap in use and the heap goal for the next GC.

panels.title: Goroutines and threads
panels.description: Goroutines and OS threads.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Seconds per second spent in stop-the-world GC pauses.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Heap bytes allocated per second.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open FDs against the process limit.
